title: Rename Symbol
summary: Renames a symbol across the whole indexed project
intro: Read this instead of a text find and replace when a symbol appears in many units. It renames the symbol and every reference the index knows about across the indexed project in one step (Ctrl+Alt+R in the IDE).

steps: Put the caret on the symbol in the editor (Ctrl+Alt+R)
Enter the new name and review the affected places
Confirm; backups are written unless disabled

surfaces.usage: drag-lint rename --kind symbol --name <QName> --to <New> [--json|--plan|--apply|--no-backup] [--project <X.dproj>] [--library-db <lib>] --db <db> - cross-unit rename, proved per occurrence; --apply passes the compile gate
help:
drag-lint rename --kind symbol --name --to [--json|--plan|--apply|--no-backup] [--project ] [--library-db ] [--platform

] [--rsvars ] [--build-timeout ] --db - cross-unit rename, every occurrence proved; --apply refuses what it cannot prove (exit 2) and passes the compile gate
drag-lint rename --kind param  --in <F> --line <L> --col <C> --to <New> [--db <db>] [--json|--plan|--apply|--no-backup] [--project <X.dproj>]  - routine-local rename (param/var autofix)
drag-lint rename --qname <Foo.TBar.Baz> --to <NewName> [--in <F>] [--db PATH] [--dry-run] [--no-backup]   (--in: file the name was asked from; ranks the not-found candidates)
(--qname and --kind symbol refuse, exit 2, and name the file(s) when the old name is used as an identifier in an .inc file: the index records no identifier references inside {$I} included text)

(an event handler rename also rewrites its text .dfm binding, OnClick = Name; a binary .dfm that holds the name refuses, exit 2, naming the file; other binary or unindexed .dfm files are reported as not rewritten, never skipped silently)

questions.ask: How do I rename a symbol in every unit that uses it?
